name: Jason
preview: Sarah: Take care, Jason. Everything's on track for October 31, and we're here whenever you want those solar numbers run.

messages.text: Happy to. Which miner are you looking at, and where are you mining from? If you give me your order number I'll pull the address off it and run it against that.
I've got the order number. What's the email on the order, or the name it ships to? Either one works and I'll pull it up.

Jason, these are for (address hidden), the address on your order. The tool didn't have an Ontario rate, so it used a generic 17 cents per kWh. Tell me your real rate and I'll rerun it.

Magic Miner 40T, the one you've got coming: about 57,500 sats a month, worth roughly $48.55 today. Power at 650 W runs about $80.62 a month at that rate. Break-even BTC price $140,304. Solo block odds about 1 in 164,985 a day, 0.22% over a year, for a 3.15 BTC block.

Harlo B30: about 43,100 sats a month, $36.42, power $50.23 at 405 W, break-even $116,560.

At a real Ontario rate the B30 looks a lot better on power. Your 40T ships October 31.

At 10 cents in (address hidden), both go positive.

Magic Miner 40T: about 57,460 sats a month, worth $48.55 today. Power $47.42 a month. Net plus $1.13. Break-even BTC $82,532, so you're just over the line. Solo odds 1 in 164,985 a day, 0.22% over a year.

Harlo B30: about 43,100 sats, $36.42. Power $29.55. Net plus $6.87. Break-even $68,565, much more headroom if BTC dips.

The 40T stacks more sats, the B30 is the safer one on power. Today's numbers, they move with price and difficulty.

Then the power side mostly falls away. If solar covers, say, half your running hours, your effective rate is nearer 5 cents and both units clear break-even comfortably. Tell me roughly what share of the day solar covers and I'll rerun it at that effective rate.

Worth knowing: with Harlo OS you can schedule power modes by time of day, so you can run high while the sun's up and dial back overnight. You've already got Harlo OS on this order.

Any time, Jason. Your 40T ships October 31, and a copy of this whole conversation comes to your email once we're done here. If you want the solar numbers rerun later, just come back with the share of the day it covers.
are there any delays of shipment?

No delay on your order. The Magic Miner 40T ships October 31, and the Harlo OS and overclocking go out with it. Tracking comes to the email on the order as soon as it's labelled, so worth whitelisting us so it doesn't land in spam.
Take care, Jason. Everything's on track for October 31, and we're here whenever you want those solar numbers run.
